remarks: Welcome to Regents Park! Westport's premiere gated community for condominium living. This end unit, 2 bedroom, 3.5 bath townhouse offers a 2 story foyer that leads to a large kitchen, dining and living area. The kitchen has a skylight, pantry and built-in desk area. The living room includes built-ins, a gas fireplace, an adjacent bar area and sliders to private deck. The second level offers a lovely landing area with built-ins and laundry area. The Primary bedroom has a walk in closet and full bath. The 2nd bedroom also has a full bath and 2 closets. The best surprise of all is the 3rd floor loft with full bath that could be the perfect office or 3rd bedroom. There are many different storage areas including the full unfinished basement that has a walk out patio. Residents of Regents Park enjoy access to an outdoor swimming pool, clubhouse and tennis court. Conveniently located near restaurants, shops,food stores and other Westport attractions including the beautiful coastline and beaches.
